text:
priya: heads-up: after a merge we've seen ArgoCD start a sync while Atlantis `apply` is still running. any simple handshake patterns people recommend to avoid half-applied infra? :sweat_smile:

marco: we've used a couple. one light-weight approach is a marker object in S3/GCS that Atlantis PUTs in `post_apply`, then a downstream GH Actions job waits for that object before calling ArgoCD. keeps creds in GH Secrets.

linh: we did a k8s-annotation pattern too: Atlantis annotates the target namespace `infra.redwood/ready=false` and flips to `true` when done; ArgoCD app has a pre-sync hook that checks the annotation. downside is giving Atlantis cluster access.

priya: we prefer not to give Atlantis cross-cluster kube perms. want an external marker it can PUT.

marco: another clean option is GitHub Checks/Status API: Atlantis updates a check-run on the commit to `completed: success` in `post_apply`. A GH Actions job waiting on that check then triggers ArgoCD. All tokens stay in GH.

jordan: we built a tiny signed webhook (lambda) in front of a repo_dispatch flow: Atlantis posts a signed request to the lambda, lambda verifies HMAC using a Vault secret then enqueues to SQS or triggers a workflow. More components but no long-lived ArgoCD creds in Atlantis.

ci-bot: summary of patterns: S3/GCS marker, DynamoDB row, GitHub Check/Status, repository_dispatch with signed webhook, Vault-proxied token fetch.

linh: small notes: for S3 markers, ensure per-PR/per-sha keys and cleanup TTLs; watch eventual-consistency for some providers if you list buckets.

marco: concrete S3 flow we used: Atlantis `post_apply` -> PUT `s3://infra-sync-markers/<repo>/<sha>.ready`. GH Actions pre-sync job polls S3 (3s interval, 5m timeout) then calls ArgoCD. store ARGOCD token in GH Secrets. works at scale for us.

priya: repo_dispatch + lambda appeals to me to avoid polling. is HMAC verification enough?

jordan: yes, HMAC on body with a Vault-stored secret is fine. lambda then writes a signed record to an audit bucket and pushes to SQS. worker consumes and calls ArgoCD with a short-lived token. we avoid exposing tokens to Atlantis.

linh: security note: scope ArgoCD tokens to app-level or use service account tokens where possible. rotate tokens regularly.

marco: fallback GH Actions wait snippet (pseudo):
```
- name: Wait for Atlantis marker
  run: |
    for i in {1..100}; do
      aws s3 ls s3://infra-sync-markers/${{ github.repository }}/${{ github.sha }}.ready && break
      sleep 3
    done
- name: Trigger ArgoCD
  run: |
    curl -X POST "https://argocd.internal/api/v1/applications/$APP/sync" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.ARGOCD_TOKEN }}" -d '{"revision":"'${{ github.sha }}'"}'
```

priya: action items: jordan to prototype the signed repo_dispatch lambda; marco to author the GH Actions poll job as a fallback. i'll send a list of apps/namespaces that need gating (infra/* and clusters/shared/*).
